a: Magandang gabi means good evening/night greeting.
Excuse me / sorry to interrupt is often Mawalang-galang or excuse me.
Magkano ito? means How much is this?
Nasaan ang banyo? means Where is the bathroom?
Hindi ko alam means I don't know.
See you is often Kita tayo or See you.
Congratulations is Binabati kita or Congrats.
